title: Rewrite the likeness and quality tasks with NumPy and larger cycles
body: Commit 636e39821 (2026-05-06, "Improve speed of quality and likeness tasks") replaced Python dictionary loops in the likeness sweep with NumPy array work. It raised the number of pictures handled per cycle (MAX_A_PER_CYCLE) from 256 to 2048, added a per-sweep cache of decoded candidate arrays, and pruned each picture's top pairs in one SQL statement.
